_readme: Copy to config.json (same folder) and fill in. No secrets here: passwords come from the toolkit .env (see ENV_KEYS.md). Ids the build creates are written to state/ids.json.

org.org_id_v3: <22-char v3 org id of the org you build into; also pass it as --expect-org>
org.org_name: <org name as shown in Administrator (only written into the package metadata)>

agent.name: <Secure Agent name as shown in Administrator > Runtime Environments (CAI 'Run On' target)>
agent.runtime_environment: <runtime environment (agent group) name, for the CDI tasks and connections>
agent.runtime_environment_id: <v2 id of that runtime environment, e.g. from: python 'toolkit/lib/idmc_session.py' get v2 /api/v2/runtimeEnvironment>

project.name: Message Bus Replacement
project.description: Legacy message bus (JMS topics, subscriber adapters, hospital retry) replaced by Kafka + CAI. Synthetic data only.

ledger_api._note: PostgREST over the Postgres ops ledger + stand-in targets (infra/). The agent calls it on the host loopback.

retry._note: Defaults; the live values are read by CAI from the ledger (table mbr.config) on every message.

cdi_batch.template_task_id: <v2 id of ANY mapping task built on the Add-On Bundle template dsst__copy_data_new_tgt (see BUILD.md step 9)>

schedule.name: sch_mbr_nightly_0230
schedule.timezone_note: v2 schedule times are pod-local; see core idmc_taskflow_schedule.py
